## Book rationale

- **replay.ch5-values.2026-11-001** (chiitoi_vs_toitoi): Keep the set and build toitoi: no pair is futile, so the 2s triplet can grow into the four sets. Discard the lone tile 2s.
- **replay.ch5-values.2026-11-005** (chiitoi_vs_toitoi): Stay with chiitoitsu: the 2p pair is futile, so toitoi can never complete. Discard the drawn R.
